title: Model a rectangle area problem with a quadratic equation

source_reference.notes: Original Edexcel 4MA1 Higher-style item for the Year 10 quadratics MVP. Edexcel pivot metadata applied.

problem_text: A rectangle has length (x + 5) cm and width (x + 2) cm. Its area is 54 cm^2. Form an equation in x and solve it.
student_prompt: Show the equation you form and give the positive value of x.

error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: Area of a rectangle is length multiplied by width, not length added to width.
The negative root does not make sense for this length context. Use the positive value of x.

hint_ladder.title: What relationship describes the situation?
hint_ladder.prompt: For a rectangle, area comes from multiplying length and width. Do not use perimeter thinking.

hint_ladder.title: Pick a starting move
hint_ladder.prompt: Write an equation by multiplying the two side expressions and setting the product equal to the given area.

hint_ladder.title: A common slip
hint_ladder.prompt: Many students solve the algebra but forget that a length context may reject a negative value.

hint_ladder.title: The general pattern
hint_ladder.prompt: For area word problems, form product = area, rearrange to a quadratic equation, solve, then check which solution makes sense in context. Apply this pattern; do not copy an example.

common_errors: does not set area equal to 54
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: The stuck point is forming the area equation from the context.
The stuck point is expanding and rearranging into a quadratic equation.

common_errors: does not check in the original area
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: The stuck point is solving and checking the value in the original context.

common_errors: does not reject the negative length
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: The stuck point is rejecting the value that does not make sense for a rectangle length.

mark_scheme_notes: Award marks for area equation, expansion/rearrangement, factorisation, and contextual positive value.
examiner_report_notes: Likely errors: adding dimensions instead of multiplying, failing to reject the negative root.
metacognition_prompt: Before you start, which formula connects the measurements in the problem?
